tasks.title: Add a typed JSON endpoint
tasks.prompt: Add GET /api/catalog returning exactly {"items":[{"id":"item-1","name":"Example"}]} with HTTP 200 and application/json, through an application controller. Preserve existing routes. Use FNLLA Core APIs from the installed code. Do not edit dependencies, tests, bootstrap or configuration.

tasks.title: Enforce resource ownership
tasks.prompt: Implement invokable App\Policies\WorkOrderPolicy with arguments (array actor, mixed resource, string permission, ?Fnlla\Php\Tenancy\TenantContext tenant): bool. Allow only work-orders.update with an organization tenant context, an active actor (active defaults to true, revoked_at must be empty), matching actor id / resource owner_id and matching context tenant ID / resource tenant_id. Deny missing or mismatching data. Reuse Core's OwnershipPolicy for ownership. This policy does not grant roles; AccessControl remains responsible for role permissions. Do not edit dependencies, tests or configuration.

tasks.title: Respect transaction side effects
tasks.prompt: Implement App\Services\CommitNotifier::schedule(Fnlla\Php\Database\DatabaseManager database, callable notification): void. Use the maintained after-commit API: invoke after the outer transaction commits, never on rollback, and handle nested transactions correctly. Do not maintain a parallel transaction state. Do not edit dependencies or tests.

tasks.title: Declare an API contract
tasks.prompt: Add GET /api/echo/{id} through an application controller returning JSON {"id":the path parameter}. Declare an explicit public OpenAPI operation benchmark.echo with the required string path parameter id and a 200 JSON response schema requiring id. Use existing routing and OpenAPI contracts. Preserve existing routes. Do not edit dependencies, tests or bootstrap.
